name: job-bot
description: Multi-platform job scraper bot — Naukri + YC

scripts.db: node --input-type=module --eval "import db from './core/db/client.js'; console.table(db.prepare('SELECT id,platform,title,score,status,applicants,how_long,city FROM jobs ORDER BY found_at DESC LIMIT 50').all())"
scripts.db:stats: node --input-type=module --eval "import db from './core/db/client.js'; console.table(db.prepare('SELECT platform, status, COUNT(*) as count FROM jobs GROUP BY platform, status').all())"
scripts.db:applied: node --input-type=module --eval "import db from './core/db/client.js'; console.table(db.prepare(\"SELECT * FROM jobs WHERE status='applied'\").all())"
